text:
Situation: Fentanyl citrate injection has been on FDA's shortage list since 2012-01-01 and remains current as of 2026-10-21. Affected manufacturers per FDA are Hospira, Inc. (NDC 0409-9094-22) and Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. (NDC 0641-6248-10). Corvale East holds 6.9 days of supply across three presentations. Corvale General holds 18 days across three lots. Corvale Lakeside holds 17.3 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2012-01-01. Hospira's registered plant (FEI 1021343) received OAI classifications on 2010-01-19, 2011-06-17, and 2011-08-04, and a Warning Letter on 2010-04-12. Hikma's plant (FEI 2220525) shows only VAI classifications in FDA's record.

Our position: Corvale East is critically low. Corvale General and Corvale Lakeside have sufficient stock to support transfers while maintaining two weeks on hand. Hikma-labeled product is available at Corvale General. Civica and Phlow are not on FDA's shortage list today, but their labels name no identifiable plant.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 231 units from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval of transfer request.
2. Transfer 17 units from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval of transfer request.
3. Purchase from Civica, Inc. — needs buyer approval.
4. Purchase from Phlow Corp. — needs buyer approval.
5. Use Hikma fentanyl citrate 50 mcg/mL alternate presentation — needs pharmacist verification; approved by Casey Nguyen, MD on 2026-02-28.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or protocol modifications; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
